A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SiNGER research and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–L. All scientific material can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: v3 reports original distillation benchmarks, component ablations and representation analyses, including the teacher–student comparisons and entropy analysis in Appendices C and J.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the multi-task evaluations in Table 1, ablations in Tables 4–7 and appendix results in Tables 10–11.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same frozen-teacher LoRA adapter, approximate-nullspace initialization and combined distillation, outlier-suppression and information-preservation losses. No algorithm or architecture changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same classification, segmentation, depth, long-tail, domain-shift and fine-grained datasets listed in Section 4.1 and Table 1. Appendix evaluation coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: FitNet and ViTKD participation is unchanged within the corresponding comparisons in Tables 1, 2 and 10. The non-distilled reference models and Table 8's full-Jacobian comparator are also retained.

E3.justification: The model pairings, linear-evaluation metrics, subset-based ablations and experimental procedures remain unchanged. Appendix K retains the same 100-epoch training schedule, batch size of 512 and 224×224 inputs.

E4.justification: The initialization, loss, hyperparameter and layer-selection ablations are unchanged. Both versions also retain the same approximation-error, spectral, feature-visualization, subspace-correlation and long-tail analyses.

E5.justification: The per-image statistical summaries in Tables 3 and 5b and the appendix distribution summaries are unchanged. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: The matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains SiNGER's ViT-L→ViT-T results of 70.59 IN-val top-1 accuracy and 0.9406 NYUd-v2 RMSE.

T1.justification: The nullspace conditions, FFN linearization and SVD derivations, Appendix A's approximate-nullspace bound and Appendix I's subspace-energy definition are unchanged. Terminology corrections do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about suppressing artifacts while preserving teacher information and improving student transfer and interpretability. No scientific contribution is added, strengthened or narrowed.

C2.justification: The explanations of ViTKD blurring, nullspace approximation, cleaner-teacher behavior and long-tail degradation retain their meaning. Both versions acknowledge that suppressing artifacts does not eliminate their underlying causes.

D1.justification: v4 adds an explicit code-availability statement and SiNGER repository address to the abstract; v3 only promises future release in Appendix K. Implementation details are unchanged, and v4 retains that future-release wording. The PDFs do not establish the repository's contents.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Reference-list differences are pagination changes caused by the new acknowledgments paragraph.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited grammar and terminology corrections, including 'accross' to 'across' and 'null space' to 'nullspace', and clarifies 'Selecting the distillation layers'. It adds acknowledgments while retaining the existing scientific section and appendix organization.

P2.justification: v4 removes the mathematical label above Figure 6's colorbar and expands 'btw' to 'between' in Figure 11's caption. Local text and reference reflow changes layout, but no figures or tables are added or removed, and plotted data remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new code locator improves access documentation, and wording corrections modestly improve readability. These limited gains outweigh the small loss of explanatory labeling in Figure 6. Scientific evidence remains unchanged, and Appendix K's unrevised future-release statement means the PDFs establish better access information rather than verified reproducibility.
